security_controls_verified.details: Unified run_authorized_websocket handler deployed across /ws/events, /ws/alerts, /ws/sightings with cookie authentication, origin validation, bounded queues, and periodic session revalidation.
Permission downgrade or subscription revocation closes socket with code 4403; account disable or session revocation closes with code 4401.
Literal '*' is structurally excluded from ConnectionManager._client_topics for authenticated clients; wildcard expands into permitted explicit topic set.

Comprehensive rollback and compensation on fail-closed audit log error verified with 100% test coverage across USER_CREATE, USER_UPDATE, USER_PASSWORD_RESET, TARGET_CREATE, TARGET_UPDATE, TARGET_DISABLE, ALERT_ACK.

Canonical ROUTE_POLICY table covering 100% of FastAPI routes validated against dynamic app.routes. Parameterized Method x Route x Role matrix evaluated across UNAUTHENTICATED, ADMIN, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR, AUDITOR.

Real AST and regex scanner verified zero unreviewed dangerous sinks across production Python/TS files. SQL parameterization and extra='forbid' mass-assignment rejection enforced on all mutation request models.
npm audit --omit=dev passed with 0 vulnerabilities; 299/299 backend tests passed; 47/47 frontend tests passed; Vite production build completed with zero errors.
